overlap.stratum: parent x prefix x task x J8 eligibility
overlap.chance_overlap: n_old * n_new / N within each stratum; zero contribution if N=0
overlap.primary: sum of observed minus expected overlap counts / 40; percentage points of all 4000 state-case observations, equal parent/prefix/task weighting
secondary: chance expectation additionally stratified on J0
Jaccard and directional event repeat rates, prevalence-dependent

history.contrast: newly_observed loss risk minus persistent_observed loss risk; old and new futures separately
history.matching: only parent x prefix x task strata with both groups represented
history.within_parent_weight: N01*N11/(N01+N11), identical for both futures and fixed by baseline histories
history.across_parent_weight: equal among parents with common support; report exact number and coverage
sensitivity: equal supported-stratum weights within each parent

uncertainty.case_resampling: within parent x task x joint history (J0,J8_prefix4201,J8_prefix4202), resample the same number of case indices with replacement; share indices across both prefixes and futures, preserving observed history denominators
uncertainty.case_scope: conditional on trained policies and observed baseline-history composition; not new training futures or population confirmation
uncertainty.interval: pointwise percentile 2.5/97.5, linear; exploratory, no multiple-testing or progression claim
uncertainty.parent_resampling: all 3125 ordered five-parent draws after within-parent aggregation; descriptive only
